preconditions.expression: A > 0 and B > 0 and A <= 20 and B <= 20
preconditions.description: The dimensions A and B of the picture are positive integers not exceeding 20.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == B for line in picture)
preconditions.description: Each line in the picture has exactly B symbols.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isupper() for c in line) for line in picture)
preconditions.description: The picture contains only uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of possible good puzzles is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(smallest_puzzle_size, tuple) and len(smallest_puzzle_size) == 2 and all(isinstance(dim, int) and dim > 0 for dim in smallest_puzzle_size)
postconditions.description: The smallest possible element size is a tuple of two positive integers (X, Y).

postconditions.expression: all(A % X == 0 and B % Y == 0 for X, Y in good_puzzles)
postconditions.description: For each good puzzle (X, Y), A is divisible by X and B is divisible by Y.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(pieces)) == len(pieces) for X, Y in good_puzzles for pieces in [get_pieces(picture, X, Y)])
postconditions.description: Each good puzzle (X, Y) has all unique pieces when rotations are considered.

postconditions.expression: smallest_puzzle_size == min(good_puzzles, key=lambda x: (x[0] * x[1], x[0]))
postconditions.description: The smallest possible element size is the one with the minimal area XY, and if there are multiple, the minimal X.
